description: FK ngày snapshot — Driving Date từ mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt (VNINDEX) [Driving Table: mkt_indx_snpst WHERE indx_code = 'VNINDEX'; grain key: tdg_dt → snpst_dt]
etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.dt = mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX'

description: Ngày snapshot [Driving Table: mkt_indx_snpst WHERE indx_code = 'VNINDEX'; grain key: tdg_dt → snpst_dt]
etl_logic: mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX'

description: Độ lệch chuẩn lợi suất VN-Index 30 phiên (σ)
etl_logic: STDDEV_SAMP(LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val / LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val) OVER (ORDER BY mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt))) OVER (ORDER BY mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX'

description: Z-score biến động giá VN-Index
etl_logic: (fct_mkt_rsk_snpst.vol_30d - AVG(fct_mkt_rsk_snpst.vol_30d) OVER ()) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(fct_mkt_rsk_snpst.vol_30d) OVER (),0)

description: Z-score thanh khoản ILLIQ [JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt → (AVG(ABS(LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val/LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val)))/NULLIF(scr_mtch_log.acm_val,0)) OVER (ORDER BY scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt ROWS 29 PRECEDING) - AVG(hist_illiq)) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(hist_illiq),0)
source_entity: Market Index Snapshot / Security Match Log

description: Z-score dư nợ margin / MCAP [JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val + scr_tdg_snpst ON rpt_dt/tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' INNER JOIN scr_tdg_snpst ON scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_tdg_snpst.stk_tp_code IN ('2','S','U','E','3') → (SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val.val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc * scr_tdg_snpst.tot_listing_vol),0) - AVG(hist_margin_ratio)) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(hist_margin_ratio),0)
source_entity: Member Report Indicator Value / Security Trading Snapshot
source_attribute: Value / Close Price / Total Listing Volume

description: Z-score lãi suất liên ngân hàng [JOIN rsk_ind_val ON rsk_ind_val.prd_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_ind_val ON rsk_ind_val.prd_dt = snpst_dt AND rsk_ind_val.bsn_key = 'INTERBANK_IR' → (rsk_ind_val.val - AVG(rsk_ind_val.val) OVER ()) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(rsk_ind_val.val) OVER (),0)

description: Z-score dòng tiền ròng NĐTNN (đảo chiều) [JOIN scr_tdg_snpst ON scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_tdg_snpst ON scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_tdg_snpst.flr_code IN ('02','04','10') → (AVG(frgn_flow_hist) - SUM(scr_tdg_snpst.frgn_buy_vol * scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) + SUM(scr_tdg_snpst.frgn_sell_vol * scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc)) / NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(frgn_flow_hist),0)
source_attribute: Foreign Buy Volume / Foreign Sell Volume / Close Price

description: Tổng vốn hóa thị trường (tỷ VND) [JOIN scr_tdg_snpst ON scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_tdg_snpst ON scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_tdg_snpst.stk_tp_code IN ('2','S','U','E','3') → SUM(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc * scr_tdg_snpst.tot_listing_vol)

description: Tỷ lệ dư nợ margin / Tổng vốn hóa (%) [JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val + scr_tdg_snpst ON rpt_dt/tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' INNER JOIN scr_tdg_snpst ON scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_tdg_snpst.stk_tp_code IN ('2','S','U','E','3') → SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val.val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc * scr_tdg_snpst.tot_listing_vol),0) * 100
source_entity: Member Report Indicator Value / Security Trading Snapshot
source_attribute: Value / Close Price / Total Listing Volume

description: Tỷ trọng yếu tố biến động
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_wgt_cfg ON rsk_wgt_cfg.risk_factor_code = 'VOLATILITY' AND rsk_wgt_cfg.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM rsk_wgt_cfg WHERE risk_factor_code = 'VOLATILITY' AND effective_date <= snpst_dt) → rsk_wgt_cfg.weight

description: Tỷ trọng yếu tố thanh khoản
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_wgt_cfg ON rsk_wgt_cfg.risk_factor_code = 'LIQUIDITY' AND rsk_wgt_cfg.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM rsk_wgt_cfg WHERE risk_factor_code = 'LIQUIDITY' AND effective_date <= snpst_dt) → rsk_wgt_cfg.weight

description: Tỷ trọng yếu tố dư nợ margin
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_wgt_cfg ON rsk_wgt_cfg.risk_factor_code = 'MARGIN' AND rsk_wgt_cfg.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM rsk_wgt_cfg WHERE risk_factor_code = 'MARGIN' AND effective_date <= snpst_dt) → rsk_wgt_cfg.weight

description: Tỷ trọng yếu tố lãi suất
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_wgt_cfg ON rsk_wgt_cfg.risk_factor_code = 'INTEREST_RATE' AND rsk_wgt_cfg.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM rsk_wgt_cfg WHERE risk_factor_code = 'INTEREST_RATE' AND effective_date <= snpst_dt) → rsk_wgt_cfg.weight

description: Tỷ trọng yếu tố dòng tiền NĐTNN
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_wgt_cfg ON rsk_wgt_cfg.risk_factor_code = 'FOREIGN_FLOW' AND rsk_wgt_cfg.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM rsk_wgt_cfg WHERE risk_factor_code = 'FOREIGN_FLOW' AND effective_date <= snpst_dt) → rsk_wgt_cfg.weight

description: Tỷ trọng yếu tố huy động vốn cổ phần
etl_logic: INNER JOIN rsk_wgt_cfg ON rsk_wgt_cfg.risk_factor_code = 'EQUITY_RAISE' AND rsk_wgt_cfg.effective_date = (SELECT MAX(effective_date) FROM rsk_wgt_cfg WHERE risk_factor_code = 'EQUITY_RAISE' AND effective_date <= snpst_dt) → rsk_wgt_cfg.weight

description: Chỉ số tâm lý giao dịch toàn thị trường (0–100) [JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt → SUM(K_sentmnt_scr_i * scr_mtch_log.acm_val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val),0)

description: Trạng thái Sentiment Index (Extreme Fear/Pessimistic/Neutral/Optimistic/Euphoria) [JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt → CASE WHEN SUM(K_sentmnt_scr_i * scr_mtch_log.acm_val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val),0) <= 20 THEN 'Extreme Fear' WHEN SUM(K_sentmnt_scr_i * scr_mtch_log.acm_val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val),0) <= 40 THEN 'Pessimistic' WHEN SUM(K_sentmnt_scr_i * scr_mtch_log.acm_val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val),0) <= 60 THEN 'Neutral' WHEN SUM(K_sentmnt_scr_i * scr_mtch_log.acm_val) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val),0) <= 80 THEN 'Optimistic' ELSE 'Euphoria' END

description: Chỉ số độ căng margin = Tổng dư nợ / Tổng hạn mức × 100 [JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin ON mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh ON mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.rpt_ind_code = 'VON_CHU_SO_HUU' → SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.val) / NULLIF(SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.val) * 2,0) * 100

description: Trạng thái Margin Tension (Dư dả/Tối ưu/Căng/Báo động/Vi phạm) [JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin ON mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh ON mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.rpt_ind_code = 'VON_CHU_SO_HUU' → CASE WHEN SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.val)/NULLIF(SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.val)*2,0)*100 < 50 THEN 'Dư dả' WHEN SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.val)/NULLIF(SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.val)*2,0)*100 < 70 THEN 'Tối ưu' WHEN SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.val)/NULLIF(SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.val)*2,0)*100 < 85 THEN 'Căng' WHEN SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_margin.val)/NULLIF(SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val_vcsh.val)*2,0)*100 < 95 THEN 'Báo động' ELSE 'Vi phạm' END

description: Chỉ số biến động hệ thống = σ_current_annualized / σ_max × 100
etl_logic: STDDEV_SAMP(LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val/LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val))) * SQRT(252) / NULLIF(MAX(hist_sigma_annualized),0) * 100 WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX'

description: Trạng thái Systemic Vol — PENDING (threshold cấu hình từ rsk_wgt_cfg)
Tổng GTGD khớp lệnh toàn thị trường ngày t (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val)

datamart_attribute: Trading Value Prev Day Bil VND
description: Tổng GTGD khớp lệnh ngày giao dịch trước (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = (SELECT MAX(tdg_dt) FROM scr_mtch_log WHERE tdg_dt < snpst_dt AND mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3')) AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val)

description: % thay đổi GTGD phiên so ngày trước
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → (SUM(CASE WHEN scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt THEN scr_mtch_log.acm_val END) - SUM(CASE WHEN scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = (SELECT MAX(tdg_dt) FROM scr_mtch_log WHERE tdg_dt < snpst_dt AND mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3')) THEN scr_mtch_log.acm_val END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = (SELECT MAX(tdg_dt) FROM scr_mtch_log WHERE tdg_dt < snpst_dt AND mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3')) THEN scr_mtch_log.acm_val END),0) * 100

datamart_attribute: Trading Value Period Total Bil VND
description: Tổng GTGD tích lũy kỳ (tuần/tháng) (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt BETWEEN period_start AND snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val)

description: Tổng dư nợ margin tất cả CTCK (tỷ VND) [JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = snpst_dt]
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = snpst_dt AND mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' → SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val.val)

description: Quy mô lệnh trung bình = SUM(GTGD khớp)/COUNT(lệnh khớp) ngày t (triệu VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val) / NULLIF(COUNT(scr_mtch_log.scr_mtch_log_id),0)
source_attribute: Accumulated Value / Security Match Log Id

description: Tổng khối lượng khớp lệnh toàn thị trường ngày t
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol)

description: Trung bình GTGD khớp lệnh 50 phiên giao dịch gần nhất tại ngày t (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → AVG(daily_gtgd) OVER (ORDER BY snpst_dt ROWS BETWEEN 49 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) WHERE daily_gtgd = SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val) GROUP BY scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt

datamart_attribute: Margin Debt Current Period Bil VND
description: Dư nợ margin CTCK kỳ hiện tại (tháng t — kỳ báo cáo gần nhất ≤ snpst_dt) (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val ON mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_rpt_ind_val.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt <= snpst_dt) → SUM(mbr_rpt_ind_val.val)

datamart_attribute: Margin Debt Previous Period Bil VND
description: Dư nợ margin CTCK kỳ liền trước kỳ hiện tại (tháng t-1) (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_cur ON mbr_cur.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_cur.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt <= snpst_dt) INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_prev ON mbr_prev.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_prev.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt < mbr_cur.rpt_dt) → SUM(mbr_prev.val)

description: Δ Margin Balance = dư nợ kỳ hiện tại − dư nợ kỳ trước (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_cur ON mbr_cur.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_cur.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt <= snpst_dt) INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_prev ON mbr_prev.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_prev.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt < mbr_cur.rpt_dt) → SUM(mbr_cur.val) - SUM(mbr_prev.val)

datamart_attribute: Avg Trading Value N Day Bil VND
description: GTGD bình quân N phiên giao dịch gần nhất tính đến snpst_dt (mặc định N=30) (tỷ VND)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → AVG(daily_gtgd) OVER (ORDER BY snpst_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) WHERE daily_gtgd = SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val) GROUP BY scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt

description: Tỷ lệ bão hòa đòn bẩy = ABS(Δ Margin) / Avg Trading Value × 100 (%)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_cur ON mbr_cur.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_cur.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt <= snpst_dt) INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_prev ON mbr_prev.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_prev.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt < mbr_cur.rpt_dt) INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → ABS(SUM(mbr_cur.val) - SUM(mbr_prev.val)) / NULLIF(AVG(daily_gtgd) OVER (ORDER BY snpst_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0) * 100 WHERE daily_gtgd = SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val) GROUP BY scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt
source_entity: Member Report Indicator Value / Security Match Log

description: Trạng thái Margin Stress: An toàn / Theo dõi / Thận trọng / Cảnh báo (ngưỡng cấu hình)
etl_logic: INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_cur ON mbr_cur.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_cur.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt <= snpst_dt) INNER JOIN mbr_rpt_ind_val AS mbr_prev ON mbr_prev.rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND mbr_prev.rpt_dt = (SELECT MAX(rpt_dt) FROM mbr_rpt_ind_val WHERE rpt_ind_code = 'DU_NO_MARGIN' AND rpt_dt < mbr_cur.rpt_dt) INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → CASE WHEN mrgn_strs_pct < 60 THEN 'An toàn' WHEN mrgn_strs_pct < 75 THEN 'Theo dõi' ELSE 'Thận trọng' END WHERE daily_gtgd = SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_val) GROUP BY scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt
source_entity: Member Report Indicator Value / Security Match Log

description: Z-score huy động vốn cổ phần — PENDING
Chỉ số rủi ro hệ thống tổng hợp RI — PENDING (cần Weight + Z-score hoàn chỉnh)
Mã chỉ số (luôn = 'VNINDEX') — SLICER nhóm 5 [Driving Table: mkt_indx_snpst]
etl_logic: mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX'

description: Hệ số tương quan Pearson giữa Return VN-Index và ΔLãi suất LNH trên N phiên gần nhất (mặc định N=30)
etl_logic: (SUM((LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val/LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val) OVER (ORDER BY mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt)) - avg_ret_vni) * (rsk_ind_val_ir.val - LAG(rsk_ind_val_ir.val) OVER (ORDER BY rsk_ind_val_ir.prd_dt) - avg_dir)) OVER w) / NULLIF(SQRT(SUM(POWER(LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val/LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val)) - avg_ret_vni,2)) OVER w * SUM(POWER(rsk_ind_val_ir.val - LAG(rsk_ind_val_ir.val) - avg_dir,2)) OVER w),0) WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX' AND rsk_ind_val_ir.bsn_key = 'INTERBANK_IR' WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
source_entity: Market Index Snapshot / Risk Indicator Value

description: Hệ số tương quan Pearson giữa Return VN-Index và Return DXY Index trên N phiên gần nhất (mặc định N=30)
etl_logic: (SUM((LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val/LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val) OVER (ORDER BY mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt)) - avg_ret_vni) * (LN(rsk_ind_val_dxy.val/LAG(rsk_ind_val_dxy.val) OVER (ORDER BY rsk_ind_val_dxy.prd_dt)) - avg_ret_dxy)) OVER w) / NULLIF(SQRT(SUM(POWER(LN(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val/LAG(mkt_indx_snpst.cls_indx_val)) - avg_ret_vni,2)) OVER w * SUM(POWER(LN(rsk_ind_val_dxy.val/LAG(rsk_ind_val_dxy.val)) - avg_ret_dxy,2)) OVER w),0) WHERE mkt_indx_snpst.indx_code = 'VNINDEX' AND rsk_ind_val_dxy.bsn_key = 'DXY' WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY mkt_indx_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
source_entity: Market Index Snapshot / Risk Indicator Value

description: Trạng thái tương quan VN-Index & Lãi suất LNH — PENDING (threshold chưa xác định)
Trạng thái tương quan VN-Index & DXY Index — PENDING (threshold chưa xác định)

description: Price Drawdown trung bình ngành = avg((P_max_N_phien - cls_prc) / P_max_N_phien) per stock GROUP BY ngành
etl_logic: INNER JOIN pblc_co ON pblc_co.pblc_co_code = scr_tdg_snpst.symb AND scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt → AVG((MAX(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.symb ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) / NULLIF(MAX(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.symb ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0) * 100) GROUP BY pblc_co.idy_cgy_code

description: Pvolatility trung bình ngành = avg(chuẩn hóa σ log return per stock) GROUP BY ngành; σ = STDDEV(LN(cls_prc/LAG(cls_prc))) trên 30 phiên
etl_logic: INNER JOIN pblc_co ON pblc_co.pblc_co_code = scr_tdg_snpst.symb AND scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt → AVG((STDDEV(LN(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc / NULLIF(LAG(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.symb ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt),0))) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.symb ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - MIN(STDDEV(...)) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt)) / NULLIF(MAX(STDDEV(...)) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt) - MIN(STDDEV(...)) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt),0) * 100) GROUP BY pblc_co.idy_cgy_code

description: Pselling trung bình ngành = avg(SellVolume_i / TotalVolume_i per stock) GROUP BY ngành; SellVolume = acm_vol WHERE mtch_drc_code='S' N phiên
etl_logic: INNER JOIN pblc_co ON pblc_co.pblc_co_code = scr_tdg_snpst.symb AND scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.scr_tdg_snpst_id = scr_tdg_snpst.scr_tdg_snpst_id → AVG(SUM(CASE WHEN scr_mtch_log.mtch_drc_code = 'S' THEN scr_mtch_log.acm_vol ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_mtch_log.scr_tdg_snpst_id ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_mtch_log.scr_tdg_snpst_id ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),0)) GROUP BY pblc_co.idy_cgy_code

description: StressScore ngành bình quân đơn giản (W1×Pdrawdown + W2×Pvolatility + W3×Pselling) avg across stocks; W1/W2/W3 cấu hình từ KDL
etl_logic: INNER JOIN pblc_co ON pblc_co.pblc_co_code = scr_tdg_snpst.symb AND scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt = snpst_dt INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.scr_tdg_snpst_id = scr_tdg_snpst.scr_tdg_snpst_id → AVG((0.4 * (MAX(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) OVER w_stk - scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) / NULLIF(MAX(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) OVER w_stk,0) * 100) + (0.3 * (STDDEV(LN(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc / NULLIF(LAG(scr_tdg_snpst.cls_prc) OVER (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.symb ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt),0))) OVER w_stk - sigma_min.val) / NULLIF(sigma_max.val - sigma_min.val,0) * 100) + (0.3 * SUM(CASE WHEN scr_mtch_log.mtch_drc_code='S' THEN scr_mtch_log.acm_vol ELSE 0 END) OVER w_log / NULLIF(SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol) OVER w_log,0))) GROUP BY pblc_co.idy_cgy_code WINDOW w_stk AS (PARTITION BY scr_tdg_snpst.symb ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) w_log AS (PARTITION BY scr_mtch_log.scr_tdg_snpst_id ORDER BY scr_tdg_snpst.tdg_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

description: D/E ratio ngành = SUM(Nợ phải trả row_code=300) / SUM(VCSH row_code=400) GROUP BY ngành từ BCTC năm gần nhất

description: Mã nhóm NĐT (FOREIGN/PROPRIETARY/DOMESTIC_INSTITUTION/DOMESTIC_INDIVIDUAL) — pivot 4 nhóm
etl_logic:
-- FOREIGN: scr_mtch_log.buy_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20')
-- PROPRIETARY: scr_mtch_log.buy_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30'
-- DOMESTIC_INSTITUTION: NOT FOREIGN AND NOT PROPRIETARY AND scr_mtch_log.buy_ivsr_cls_code != '8000'
-- DOMESTIC_INDIVIDUAL: scr_mtch_log.buy_ivsr_cls_code = '8000'

description: GTGD mua nhóm NĐT (tỷ VND) — 4 branches per investor group
etl_logic:
-- FOREIGN: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE buy_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20')
-- PROPRIETARY: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE buy_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30'
-- DOMESTIC_INSTITUTION: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE NOT FOREIGN AND buy_ivsr_cls_code != '8000'
-- DOMESTIC_INDIVIDUAL: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE buy_ivsr_cls_code = '8000'

description: GTGD bán nhóm NĐT (tỷ VND) — 4 branches per investor group
etl_logic:
-- FOREIGN: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE sell_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20')
-- PROPRIETARY: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE sell_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30'
-- DOMESTIC_INSTITUTION: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE NOT FOREIGN AND sell_ivsr_cls_code != '8000'
-- DOMESTIC_INDIVIDUAL: SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE sell_ivsr_cls_code = '8000'

description: Dòng tiền ròng nhóm NĐT (tỷ VND) = Buy - Sell
etl_logic:
-- FOREIGN: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE buy_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20') - SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE sell_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20')
-- PROPRIETARY: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ... → SUM(... WHERE buy_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30') - SUM(... WHERE sell_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30')
-- DOMESTIC_INSTITUTION: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ... → SUM(... WHERE NOT FOREIGN AND buy_ivsr_cls_code != '8000') - SUM(... WHERE NOT FOREIGN AND sell_ivsr_cls_code != '8000')
-- DOMESTIC_INDIVIDUAL: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ... → SUM(... WHERE buy_ivsr_cls_code = '8000') - SUM(... WHERE sell_ivsr_cls_code = '8000')

description: Dòng tiền ròng nhóm NĐT trung bình 30 phiên
etl_logic: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt <= snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → AVG(daily_net_flow) OVER (PARTITION BY ivsr_grp_code ORDER BY snpst_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) WHERE daily_net_flow = SUM(buy_vol*buy_prc) - SUM(sell_vol*sell_prc) GROUP BY tdg_dt, ivsr_grp_code

description: Hệ số tương quan Pearson NĐTNN vs Tự doanh 30 phiên
etl_logic: CORR(net_flow_foreign_30, net_flow_prop_30) OVER (ORDER BY snpst_dt ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

description: GTGD nhóm NĐT (tỷ VND) = Buy + Sell

-- FOREIGN: INNER JOIN scr_mtch_log ON scr_mtch_log.tdg_dt = snpst_dt AND scr_mtch_log.mkt_id IN ('STO','STX','UPX') AND scr_mtch_log.brd_tp_code IN ('G1','G2','G3') → SUM(scr_mtch_log.acm_vol * scr_mtch_log.mtch_prc) WHERE buy_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20') OR sell_frgn_ivsr_tp_code IN ('10','20')
-- PROPRIETARY: ... WHERE buy_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30' OR sell_clnt_hse_cls_code = '30'
-- DOMESTIC_INSTITUTION: ... WHERE NOT FOREIGN AND (buy_ivsr_cls_code != '8000' OR sell_ivsr_cls_code != '8000')
-- DOMESTIC_INDIVIDUAL: ... WHERE buy_ivsr_cls_code = '8000' OR sell_ivsr_cls_code = '8000'
